qualifications: November 2023 enrollment for academic 2023/24; not current attendance or capacity.
Localities describe school enrollment locations, not student homes or catchments.
No enrollment count is allocated to a school campus or hexagon.
Combined Hulhumeedhoo is preserved without forcing a unique island identity.
Blank published numeric cells stay null; null is not a measured zero.
Context tables repeat totals and have different scopes and units. Select one table, metric and demographic slice before analysis; never sum across tables.
Source conflicts remain published values: Greater Male totals differ between p10 (37,707) and p12/36/37 (38,836); Vaavu schools differ p12 (5)/p37 (6), and Meemu schools differ p12 (13)/p37 (12).
Dhaalu p31 aggregate male grade cells sum715 while its published subtotal is734; individual locality grade counts conserve all published nonblank subtotals.
